# CFG — Settings

- Owner: `ticonnect-settings`
- Stage: 1
- Layer: `leaves`
- Component graph: [generated/components/cfg.md](generated/components/cfg.md)

## Purpose

Load, validate, persist, and watch TOML configuration with environment overrides and atomic cross-process writes.

## Boundary

Leaf crate. No domain, network, storage, or logging dependency. Exposes effective settings only.

## Owned state

- config.toml
- effective settings snapshot

## Invariants

- `INV-CFG-1` — Configuration lives only in config.toml and SQLite stores no configuration. Test: crates/settings/src/tests.rs and crates/daemon/tests/storage.rs
- `INV-CFG-2` — Config writes are locked and atomically replace the file. Test: crates/settings/src/tests.rs
- `INV-SEC-1` — No secret, key, message body, or keystroke is logged by default. Test: planned: logging redaction tests
- `INV-STAGE-1` — Every stage demo uses only components from that stage or earlier stages. Test: cargo xtask systems --check
- `INV-STATE-1` — Every persistent store has exactly one owner component. Test: cargo xtask systems --check

## Failure semantics

- reject invalid values with typed errors
- atomic replace prevents corruption
- missing file is a no-op reset

## Open decisions

- lock behavior on NFS or unusual filesystems
- settings write conflict UX
